name: v102_ghc_ssc_minus_product_qmb_035
hypothesis: GHC/SSC conditional news is strong but blocked by product/business and QMB/editorial sleeves; a compact subtraction of both blockers may preserve a distinct GHC/relevance residual.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20) < 0.70, 0.390 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(nws18_ghc_lna), 90), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_ssc_fast_d1), 45), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(nws18_relevance_fast_d1), 45), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry) - 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_product, 90), industry) - 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_css_product, 90), industry) - 0.090 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_qmb_fast_d1), 90), industry) - 0.060 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_editorial_commentary_sentiment, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Anti Vkp0P130 + anti LLpKoQPa proxy; high risk of losing strength.

name: v102_ghc_ssc_subindustry_residual
hypothesis: Subindustry neutralization may change the product/business exposure of GHC/SSC after explicit product subtraction, even if prior news-vector subindustry variants failed.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) < 0.60, 0.420 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(nws18_ghc_lna), 90), subindustry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_ssc_fast_d1), 45), subindustry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(nws18_relevance_fast_d1), 45), subindustry) - 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_product, 90), subindustry) - 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_business, 90), subindustry) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Subindustry residual test; submit only if both LSUS and corr improve.

name: v102_fscore_contrarian_slow_lowturnover
hypothesis: Fscore contrarian value had clean low-correlation alpha but turnover was too high; a slower window, lower reversal weight, and higher decay may keep the fresh parent while meeting turnover gate.
expression: 0.360 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fscore_surface_accel, 252), industry) + 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fscore_growth, 252), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_value, 252), industry) + 0.080 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Rescue QPaYg0EQ by lowering turnover; likely Fitness-risk but genuinely fresh parent.

name: v102_fscore_contrarian_trade_slow

expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) < 0.60, 0.360 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fscore_surface_accel, 252), industry) + 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fscore_growth, 252), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_value, 252), industry) + 0.080 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Conditional fscore contrarian, no inventory/credit/sharecount sleeves.

name: v102_sales_dispersion_actual_residual

expression: 0.340 * group_rank(ts_rank(actual_sales_value_quarterly / sales_estimate_average_quarterly, 126), industry) + 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(actual_sales_value_quarterly / sales_estimate_average_quarterly, 63), 126), industry) - 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * sales_estimate_dispersion, 126), industry) - 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(sales_estimate_count, 63), 126), industry) + 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: May have field-name risk; if valid, tests old sales mechanisms as a residual not a sibling.
